{"headline": "Potential underbilling: annual price escalation never applied to Silverline Pumps", "narrative": "Contract C-2028 sets the price for MFG-1002 (Hydraulic valve block) at USD 396.25 per unit (clause A.3) and requires a compounding 2.5% increase on each anniversary of the Effective Date (clause 4.2). Billing never applied these escalations, so 20 invoice lines from 2024-05-15 to 2025-12-15 were billed at USD 396.25 instead of the latest expected USD 416.31. This is a potential underbilling of USD 69,164.22, of which an estimated USD 62,593.62 is recoverable. The suggested owner is Pricing & Billing Master Data.", "rebill_note_subject": "Internal review: F-005 potential underbilling, Silverline Pumps Ltd (C-2028)", "rebill_note_body": "Finding F-005 | Customer: Silverline Pumps Ltd | Contract: C-2028 | SKU: MFG-1002

Issue: The contractual annual price escalation was not applied in billing (potential underbilling). 20 invoice lines are affected for 2024-05-15 to 2025-12-15.

Support: Clause A.3 (page 1) sets the price at USD 396.25 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) requires a 2.5% compounding annual uplift. Calculation: USD 396.25 x (1 + 2.5%) x (1 + 2.5%) = USD 416.31. The latest billed price is USD 396.25.

Amount: USD 69,164.22 potential underbilling; estimated recoverable USD 62,593.62.

Proposed action, subject to approval: Pricing & Billing Master Data to load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2024-05-15. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for review.

No customer contact until approved."}
